name: Mint
source:
Hello, uh, my name is Mint. What do I like, you ask? I'm sorry, but... I don't think I could talk to you about those things unless I got to like you first. Then I could tell you and only you. Would you wait until that happens? It won't be very long now...

This little cockatoo of a girl, with the lonely expression on her face, does not trust people at all, because of something that happened in her past. Will she ever open up to Will she ever recover...?
